mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate profit visibility.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of industrial production growth exceeding 105.0 (INDPRO > 105.0), manufacturing sector expansion signals robust corporate earnings momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior month indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100k over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 800 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates monetary policy response to labor market weakness, which typically precedes economic slowdown and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) over the prior month indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month.
